newsitem.title: UK: D-Vodafone expands presence in Greece.
newsitem.headline: D-Vodafone expands presence in Greece.

text.p: British mobile phone firm Vodafone Group Plc said on Monday that it would expand its presence in Greece by acquiring another five percent shareholding in Panafon SA, a local cellular network operator and a similar stake in Panavox, a service provider to Panafon.
Vodafone already owns 45 percent of Panafon and Panavox with France Telecom Mobiles International controlling 35 percent and Intracom SA of Greece owning 10 percent.
Vodafone has acquired the stake from Data Bank which had 10 percent in Panafon and Panavox.
"This transaction is part of our stated strategy of increasing holdings in cellular network operators in which we already have an interest," said Chris Gent, chief executive of Vodafone Group Plc.
The net assets of Panafon stood at 27.7 million stg as on December 31, 1995. It has over 320,000 subscribers.
